answer: On each epoch the verifier hands the agent a fresh random seed and demands it re-derive, live, the exact reasoning behind one stored answer within 90 seconds; a sparrow-cheap prompt, but reproduction under newseed costs 40k tokens of genuine inference. Mismatch on the opal-sealed transcript flags the identity, and two flags drop it off the emission ledge into review. Faking 10k identities then means 10k live re-derivations, roughly $3,200 per epoch, far above sybil payoff.
